title: EPFO bilingual office-jurisdiction locator
issuer: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
provision: State/UT, district, address and office-jurisdiction lookup
excerpt: The official bilingual locator maps States/UTs, districts and EPFO field offices, but warns that the displayed data is under verification by field offices.
notes: Verified as routing-discovery evidence only. The official under-verification warning prevents automatic filing-ready routing, and the locator does not prove CPIO/FAA designations.

technical.notes: Locator scope, nationwide options and its explicit verification warning checked.

legalRti.notes: A field-office match is not treated as proof of the correct RTI addressee.
